note: Spuerkeess's Visa Classic credit card costs 24 euros a year (its fee information for the classic current account, 1 October 2025), and what's spent on it is taken from the linked current account in one go at the start of the following month, so nothing is carried; the optional revolving credit states no rate in what the bank publishes.

sources.title: Spuerkeess, Document d'information tarifaire: Compte courant classique (1 October 2025)
sources.said: Date : 01/10/2025 ... Fourniture d’une carte de crédit Visa Classic 24,00 € / an

sources.title: Spuerkeess, Debit and credit cards: what exactly is the difference?
sources.said: Amounts spent with a credit card are deducted from the linked current account in one go, generally at the beginning of the following month.
